reason: The plug and console are the only available pair, and the goal calls for arming ascent.
expectation: The plug will arm the console and allow the ascent command.

effect: The plug both armed the circuit and led directly to the ascent command, completing the chapter.
reaction: The shrinking cave and solar panels made the departure feel like a satisfying conclusion.

mostWorthwhile.text: The ascent was worthwhile because it brought the repaired spacecraft and the long-built settlement into one final image.

leastWorthwhile.text: There was only one available pair, so the final chapter offered little of a gameplay decision.

surprise.text: The combination included pressing START as well as fitting the plug; I had expected it to enable the command rather than necessarily perform it in the same action.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless: fitting an arming plug to the ascent console was clear, though the action was predetermined.

continue.text: I would continue to see what happens to the specimens, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than this final chapter offered.
